title: Battle of Valls
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Valls", at revision 1370592128, opens: "The Battle of Valls was fought on 25 February 1809, during the Peninsular War, between a French force under Laurent Gouvion Saint-Cyr and a Spanish force under Theodor von Reding. Fought near the town of Valls in Catalonia, Spain, the battle ended in a French victory. General Reding was fatally wounded during a cavalry charge against French cavalry." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q550114, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1809 battle during the Peninsular War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
